common.precedence: cancellation > auth > named quota > context > invalid/policy > timeout > rate > server > transport
common.projection: Frozen detached provider, optional api, canonical code, fixed safe message, optional real status, validated requestId and timer-safe hint; no raw text/body/header/cause/stack/account export
common.unknownApi: Policy is owned by the global harness, not this API list. Unknown APIs can inherit that policy via neutral harness errors but have no claimed SDK typed coverage.
common.concurrency: SDK owns no context/scheduler/ALS. Dispatch correlation, API validation, observer lifetime and foreign/late fact rejection belong to the parent bridge.
